steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The choreographic process is the journey from initial idea to a finished dance piece | Key Fact: It begins with selecting a stimulus — something that inspires movement creation | Key Fact: Exploration involves experimenting with movement ideas freely and without judgement | Key Fact: Selection means choosing the most effective movement material from what was explored

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the choreographic process, and one past-paper question.
